name: DisequalityDispersion.Flow.Network.sum_indeg
typeText:
∀ {ν : Type} [inst : DecidableEq.{1} ν] (U : Finset.{0} (Prod.{0, 0} ν ν)) (S : Finset.{0} ν),
  Eq.{1} (∑ x ∈ S, DisequalityDispersion.Flow.Network.indeg U x)
    (Finset.card.{0} ({a ∈ U | Membership.mem.{0, 0} S a.2}))

source.code:
theorem sum_indeg (U : Finset (ν × ν)) (S : Finset ν) :
    ∑ x ∈ S, indeg U x = (U.filter (fun a => a.2 ∈ S)).card := by
  rw [Finset.card_eq_sum_card_fiberwise (f := Prod.snd) (t := S)]
  · apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
    intro x hx
    unfold indeg
    congr 1
    ext a
    simp only [Finset.mem_filter]
    constructor
    · rintro ⟨ha, hax⟩; exact ⟨⟨ha, hax ▸ hx⟩, hax⟩
    · rintro ⟨⟨ha, _⟩, hax⟩; exact ⟨ha, hax⟩
  · intro a ha
    simp only [Finset.coe_filter, Set.mem_setOf_eq] at ha
    exact ha.2
